children: Kosmos Energy announced a notice of partial redemption for $25,000,000 of its 7.750% senior notes due 2027.
Issued notice of partial redemption for $25,000,000 aggregate principal of 7.750% senior notes due 2027.
Redemption is expected to occur on September 30, 2026, which reduces outstanding near-term debt.
Company may pursue one or more additional optional redemptions before the notes' final maturity.
This Form 8-K does not itself constitute the official notice of redemption.
